entries.label: Built
entries.title: One clause grammar for every card's rules text (2026-09-29 → 10-02)
entries.summary: Card text is now parsed once, by one grammar, into typed effects: twelve closed sub-grammars (targets, amounts, conditions, durations, destinations, payloads and more) under a five-layer spine. 72% of the 44,316 effect clauses in the Modern pool are typed; the rest are marked unparsed rather than guessed. Every card's parse is lazy, so a game parses only the cards it touches.
details: Location: engine/effect_grammar/, engine/effect_spec.py, engine/effect_views.py, engine/effect_resolver.py
Proof of neutrality: 26 seeded games byte-identical before and after every stage; legacy field equivalence measured over 2.85 million comparisons
Records: docs/design/2026-09-29_clause_and_trigger_grammar.md, docs/design/effect_grammar_census.md

entries.label: Fixed
entries.title: Temporal model and planeswalkers (2026-09-27 → 09-29)
entries.summary: Every temporary rule is one Effect with a duration on one event clock: cast prohibitions and permissions, cost reductions, draw limits, attack and block restrictions, combat-damage prevention, "until your next turn". Effects on an object end when it leaves (CR 400.7). Creatures can attack planeswalkers, loyalty lines resolve through the clause resolver, and the AI values a loyalty line by projecting its clause on the same scale as a spell.
details: Location: engine/turn_clock.py, engine/rules_query.py, engine/continuous_effects.py, engine/clause_resolver.py, ai/pw_ability.py
Counted targets are one requirement with a count (CR 115.1 / 601.2c); bounce is one typed class
Records: docs/design/2026-09-28_temporal_state_model.md, docs/design/rules-foundation-sweep-tracker.md

entries.label: Rejected
entries.title: An LLM-built tag cache cannot write game rules (2026-10-02)
entries.summary: A decision model classified every registered-deck card's mechanic tags. On a same-seed full matrix one deck gained 3.3 points from a single wrong answer: a creature tagged as gaining life on every draw, which the engine then enforced. The cache was not adopted; the lasting fix is to move the five engine rules that read classifier tags onto the parsed effects.
details: Measurement: full n=20 Bo3 matrix pre/post on the same seeds; one cell moved 65 → 45, replay-diagnosed at seed 51000
Records: docs/design/rules-foundation-sweep-tracker.md (Jev oracle-tag cache A/B)

entries.label: Fixed
entries.title: Rules enforcement as a system 09-12 → 09-13: a runtime CR auditor, a coverage census, a single-owner ratchet, and the rules gaps they name
entries.summary: The engine now notices when it breaks a rule. An opt-in runtime auditor records CR-phrased invariants across a whole matrix run; a generated census ranks every keyword the engine does not yet model; a single-owner ratchet pins each rule to one code path. The gaps that census pointed at were closed in the same pass: land types are read from the continuous-effects layer (domain and fetch under Blood Moon / Leyline, CR 305.7 / 613), combat damage is stepped per creature so first-strike blockers and blockers of first-strikers deal their damage (CR 510.2 / 510.4 / 702.7b), a spell with a required target is not cast without a legal one and every ETB target goes through the solver (CR 601.2c, hexproof), a soft counter becomes a hard counter when its printed board condition holds (ferocious, CR 601.2b), and any-target burn applies its printed conditional upgrade (metalcraft, CR 608.2).
details: Location: engine/rules_audit.py, tools/keyword_coverage.py, tools/check_single_owner.py, engine/mana_payment.py + continuous_effects.py, engine/combat_manager.py, engine/cast_manager.py + target_solver.py, engine/spell_resolution.py + oracle_parser.py

2026-09-13 matrix (n=60 per pairing, 18 000 Bo3 matches) vs 09-12: all movements sub-3pp — Creatures Toolbox 17.9 → 20.8 and Broodscale 60.7 → 62.5 (per-creature first strike), Grixis 53.8 → 55.7, Domain Zoo 69.4 → 71.6 (ferocious hard-counters, rules-correct), Boros Ponza 51.3 → 49.2 (domain under its own Blood Moon); auditor read 0 rule violations across 18 000 matches, 31 of 96 calibration checks in band
Records: docs/design/rules-foundation-sweep-tracker.md (Meta refresh 2026-09-13; Z1–Z3, R1–R3, K3, KD), docs/design/rules_coverage.md

entries.label: Fixed
entries.title: Rules-foundation sweep 09-06 → 09-12: load-invariant game budget, hybrid mana, counter triage, combat tricks, twenty-two units
entries.summary: Every measurement is now machine-independent (a CPU-time budget replaces the wall-clock deadline; drawn and aborted games are credited to nobody and stamped into every results file). Hybrid mana pips are pips, not generic (CR 107.4e / 601.2f) — the free-Manamorphose engine that inflated Storm is gone. Control decks counter per unanswered threat and answer instant-speed casts; known lock permanents fold into P(resolve); pump instants, a post-block priority window, protection, X-bound removal legality, flashback zones, dies/cast/token triggers, loot discards, and a nine-deck mulligan cap derived from the manabase.
details: Location: engine/game_budget.py, engine/mana.py + mana_payment.py + cast_manager.py, ai/response.py, ai/ev_evaluator.py, engine/game_runner.py combat steps, engine/oracle_parser.py trigger classes, decks/gameplans/*.json

2026-09-12 matrix (n=60 per pairing, 18 000 Bo3 matches) vs 09-06: Ruby Storm 63.5 → 55.2 (in band), Boros Energy 68.8 → 61.8 (in band), Izzet Prowess 52.3 → 61.2, Hollow One 28.3 → 34.0, Goryo's 41.5 → 47.2, Living End 52.3 → 56.8; Domain Zoo 60.2 → 69.4 (above band — four opponent-side units corrected play without moving a Zoo cell; loop-break doc written)
Records: docs/design/rules-foundation-sweep-tracker.md, docs/diagnostics/2026-09-06_wall_clock_deadline_load_invariance.md, docs/diagnostics/2026-09-12_zoo_lane_loop_break.md

entries.label: Fixed
entries.title: Band loops (Zoo, Pinnacle Affinity): nine rules-and-valuation classes, replay-diagnosed
entries.summary: Two self-paced loops fixed what Bo3 replays showed, one class-sized mechanic per iteration: Saga chapter timing and the response window before the final-chapter sacrifice, "with mana cost" excludes lands, lands in hand count as mana sources for a search, killing an equipped creature removes only its own power, caster-chosen hand attacks valued by the best card they take, a "target player" discard can target its caster, forced basic land type as a continuous effect, burn damage from the parsed amount, cycling credited only when the deck can return the body.
details: Location: engine/saga.py, ai/mana_planner.py, ai/ev_player.py block scorer, ai/hand_denial.py, engine/continuous_effects.py, ai/card_classes.py

2026-09-06 matrix vs 09-04: Pinnacle Affinity 67.1 → 61.5, Domain Zoo 65.6 → 60.2 (OUT → IN band), 4c Omnath 68.5 → 59.0, Creatures Toolbox 10.4 → 21.9, Grixis Reanimator 43.8 → 53.1; calibration 30 → 38 of 96 checks in band
Records: docs/diagnostics/2026-09-05_zoo_band_loop_break.md, docs/diagnostics/2026-09-06_pinnacle_band_loop_close.md

entries.label: P1 Open
entries.title: Domain Zoo structural verdict (aggregate diagnosis)
entries.summary: Root-caused across every control loss at once instead of one replay at a time: control loses on resource economy even when it sequences correctly. The band loops brought Zoo to 60.2% (09-06); the 09-12 n=60 matrix reads 69.4% again after four opponent-side units corrected play without moving a Zoo cell — the loop-break doc names the residual (Toolbox's unbounded-mana engine has no outlet; re-banding Zoo on the weighted field is an open decision).
details: Method: aggregate-diagnosis over all Zoo-vs-control losses
Verdict: economy gap is structural, not a scoring bug
See docs/diagnostics/2026-08-26_decider_loss_root_cause.md
